questions.stem: Contoso no longer wants to buy its own servers; instead it wants virtual machines, storage, databases and networking delivered over the internet whenever it needs them. What is this way of getting IT services called?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 不想再自己购买服务器，而是希望在需要时通过互联网获得虚拟机、存储、数据库和网络。这种获取 IT 服务的方式叫什么？
questions.definition: Cloud computing is the delivery of computing services over the internet. Computing services include common IT infrastructure such as virtual machines, storage, databases, and networking.
questions.zh: 云计算是通过互联网交付计算服务。计算服务包括常见的 IT 基础结构，例如虚拟机、存储、数据库和网络。

questions.stem: A new Contoso hire asks what Azure's physical infrastructure is built on at the lowest level: buildings full of servers in racks, each with dedicated power, cooling and networking. What are these facilities called?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一名新员工问 Azure 的物理基础设施在最底层由什么构成：装满机架服务器、配有专用电力、冷却和网络的建筑。这些设施叫什么？
questions.definition: The physical infrastructure for Azure starts with datacenters. These datacenters are facilities with servers arranged in racks, with dedicated power, cooling, and networking infrastructure ...
questions.zh: Azure 的物理基础结构从数据中心开始。这些数据中心是一些设施，其中的服务器排列在机架中，并配有专用的电力、冷却和网络基础结构……

questions.stem: Contoso's security team is moving workloads to Azure and wants to know which duties Microsoft now handles and which ones Contoso still owns. Which concept explains this split of duties?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的安全团队正在把工作负载迁到 Azure，想知道哪些职责现在由 Microsoft 承担、哪些仍由 Contoso 负责。哪个概念解释了这种职责划分？
questions.definition: With the shared responsibility model, these responsibilities get shared between the cloud provider and the consumer.
questions.zh: 在责任共担模型中，这些责任由云提供商和使用者共同承担。

questions.stem: Fabrikam runs all of its servers in a room inside its own office building, so its IT staff are responsible for everything from the hardware up to the applications. How is this kind of deployment described?
questions.zhStem: Fabrikam 把所有服务器放在自己办公楼内的一个机房里，因此其 IT 人员要负责从硬件到应用程序的一切。这种部署方式被称为什么？
questions.definition: With an on-premises datacenter, you’re responsible for everything.
questions.zh: 对于本地部署的数据中心，你要对一切负责。

questions.stem: After moving to Azure, Contoso asks who now takes care of the physical security, power, cooling and network connectivity of the buildings that host its workloads. Who is responsible for these?
questions.zhStem: 迁到 Azure 后，Contoso 问现在由谁负责托管其工作负载的建筑的物理安全、电力、冷却和网络连接。这些由谁负责？
questions.definition: Physical security, power, cooling, and network connectivity are the responsibility of the cloud provider.
questions.zh: 物理安全、电力、冷却和网络连接由云服务商负责。

questions.stem: A startup wants to rent compute from a third-party company that builds and runs the infrastructure and sells its services to anyone who signs up. Which cloud model is this?
questions.zhStem: 一家初创公司想向一家第三方公司租用计算资源，该公司自建并运营基础设施，任何注册的人都可以购买其服务。这是哪种云模型？
questions.definition: A public cloud is built, controlled, and maintained by a third-party cloud provider. With a public cloud, anyone that wants to purchase cloud services can access and use resources.
questions.zh: 公有云由第三方云提供商构建、控制和维护。借助公有云，任何想要购买云服务的人都可以访问和使用资源。

questions.stem: A bank wants cloud-style IT services delivered to its staff, but the environment must be used by the bank alone and never shared with any other customer. Which cloud model fits?
questions.zhStem: 一家银行希望以云的方式向员工提供 IT 服务，但该环境只能由这家银行单独使用，绝不与其他客户共享。哪种云模型合适？
questions.definition: It’s a cloud (delivering IT services over the internet) that’s used by a single entity.
questions.zh: 它是一种云（通过互联网交付 IT 服务），由单个实体使用。

questions.stem: Contoso keeps its sensitive databases in its own private environment but connects them to web servers running on Azure, so both work together as one inter-connected environment. Which cloud model is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 把敏感数据库保留在自己的私有环境中，但将其与运行在 Azure 上的 Web 服务器相连，使两者作为一个互联环境协同工作。这是哪种云模型？
questions.definition: A hybrid cloud is a computing environment that uses both public and private clouds in an inter-connected environment.
questions.zh: 混合云是一种计算环境，它在互连的环境中同时使用公有云和私有云。

questions.stem: Fabrikam runs some workloads on Azure and others on AWS, using more than one public provider at the same time. Which cloud model is this?
questions.zhStem: Fabrikam 把一些工作负载放在 Azure 上，另一些放在 AWS 上，同时使用不止一家公有云服务商。这是哪种云模型？
questions.definition: In a multi-cloud scenario, you use multiple public cloud providers.
questions.zh: 在多云场景中，你使用多个公有云提供商。

questions.stem: Contoso's finance team pays a large one-time sum up front to buy new servers and storage hardware for its office server room. Which type of expenditure is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的财务团队一次性预先支付一大笔钱，为办公室机房购买新的服务器和存储硬件。这属于哪种支出？
questions.definition: CapEx is typically a one-time, up-front expenditure to purchase or secure tangible resources.
questions.zh: CapEx 通常是一次性的前期支出，用于购买或获取有形资源。

questions.stem: After moving to Azure, Contoso's finance team no longer buys hardware; instead it pays a bill every month for the services it keeps using over time. Which type of expenditure is this?
questions.zhStem: 迁到 Azure 后，Contoso 的财务团队不再购买硬件，而是每月为持续使用的服务付账单。这属于哪种支出？
questions.definition: In contrast, OpEx is spending money on services or products over time.
questions.zh: 相比之下，OpEx 是在服务或产品上随时间推移持续花钱。

questions.stem: Contoso's CFO asks why cloud spending counts as operating cost: Azure has no up-front cost, measures what each workload actually uses, and bills only for that. What is this billing model called?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的首席财务官问为什么云支出算作运营成本：Azure 没有前期费用，它计量每个工作负载的实际用量并只按此收费。这种计费模式叫什么？
questions.definition: Cloud computing falls under OpEx because cloud computing operates on a consumption-based model.
questions.zh: 云计算属于 OpEx，因为云计算基于按用量计费模式运行。

questions.stem: A Contoso developer runs a test VM for three hours and wants to know how Azure charges for it: no contract or up-front fee, only a charge for the services actually used. Which pricing model is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一名开发人员运行一台测试虚拟机三小时，想知道 Azure 如何收费：没有合同或预付费用，只对实际使用的服务收费。这是哪种定价模式？
questions.definition: Cloud computing is the delivery of computing services over the internet by using a pay-as-you-go pricing model. You typically pay only for the cloud services you use
questions.zh: 云计算是指通过 Internet、使用按需付费定价模式交付计算服务。你通常只需为所使用的云服务付费

questions.stem: Contoso must move an old business app that depends on a custom operating system setup and special drivers. Its admins want to rent hardware from Azure but keep full control of the operating system, patches and installed software. Which cloud service type fits best?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 需要迁移一个依赖自定义操作系统配置和特殊驱动程序的旧业务应用。管理员希望从 Azure 租用硬件，但对操作系统、补丁和已安装软件保留完全控制。哪种云服务类型最合适？
questions.definition: Infrastructure as a service (IaaS) is the most flexible category of cloud services, as it provides you the maximum amount of control for your cloud resources.
questions.zh: 基础设施即服务（IaaS）是最灵活的云服务类别，因为它为你提供对云资源的最大控制权。

questions.stem: Contoso's developers want to deploy the web app code they wrote to Azure without managing servers, operating systems or patching, while still controlling the application itself. Which cloud service type fits best?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的开发人员希望把自己编写的 Web 应用代码部署到 Azure，不想管理服务器、操作系统或打补丁，但仍要控制应用本身。哪种云服务类型最合适？
questions.definition: Platform as a service (PaaS) is a middle ground between renting space in a datacenter (infrastructure as a service) and paying for a complete and deployed solution (software as a service).
questions.zh: 平台即服务（PaaS）是一种折中方案，介于在数据中心租用空间（基础设施即服务）与为完整且已部署的解决方案付费（软件即服务）之间。
keys: 完整且已部署的解决方案

questions.stem: Contoso's HR team wants a ready-made email and calendar application that the vendor fully runs and updates; staff only sign in and use it. Which cloud service type is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的人力资源团队想要一个现成的邮件和日历应用，由供应商完全负责运行和更新；员工只需登录使用。这属于哪种云服务类型？
questions.definition: With SaaS, you’re essentially renting or using a fully developed application.
questions.zh: 借助 SaaS，你实质上是在租用或使用一个完全开发好的应用程序。
keys: 完全开发好的应用程序

questions.stem: Contoso's executives want Microsoft's proven, end-to-end guidance that walks them through deciding, preparing and carrying out their whole cloud journey with less risk. Which resource should they use?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的高管希望获得 Microsoft 经过验证的端到端指导，带领他们以更低风险完成整个上云历程的决策、准备和实施。他们应该使用哪项资源？
questions.definition: The Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) helps decision makers make better decisions, faster. It provides proven guidance to reduce risk, accelerate adoption, and create a foundation that supports current and future workloads.
questions.zh: Microsoft 云采用框架（CAF）可帮助决策者更快地做出更好的决策。它提供经过验证的指导，以降低风险、加速采用，并建立支持当前和未来工作负载的基础。

questions.stem: Contoso's leaders are just starting out and are asking what their Azure move should look like and why they are doing it at all. Which CAF phase are they in?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的领导层刚刚起步，正在思考他们迁往 Azure 应该是什么样子，以及到底为什么要这样做。他们处于 CAF 的哪个阶段？
questions.definition: 1. Strategy: What should our Azure adoption look like?
questions.zh: 1. 策略阶段：我们的 Azure 采用应该是什么样子？

questions.stem: Contoso has agreed on why it is moving to Azure and now needs to turn that intent into concrete, actionable steps specific to its goals. Which CAF phase comes next?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 已就为什么迁往 Azure 达成一致，现在需要把这一意图转化为针对自身目标的具体、可执行的步骤。接下来是 CAF 的哪个阶段？
questions.definition: Successful cloud adoption ... requires a cloud adoption plan. A cloud adoption plan converts your cloud strategy into an actionable plan that's specific to your goals.
questions.zh: 成功的云采用……需要一份云采用计划。云采用计划会将你的云策略转化为针对你的目标的可执行计划。

questions.stem: Before moving any workloads, Contoso's platform team designs its Azure landing zone so the environment meets the organization's requirements. Which CAF phase is this?
questions.zhStem: 在迁移任何工作负载之前，Contoso 的平台团队设计其 Azure 登陆区，使环境满足组织的要求。这是 CAF 的哪个阶段？
questions.definition: The Ready phase of the Cloud Adoption Framework helps you design your Azure landing zone to meet your organization's requirements.
questions.zh: 云采用框架的就绪阶段可帮助你设计 Azure 落地区，以满足组织的要求。

questions.stem: Contoso's teams are now actually moving, improving and building workloads in Azure. Which CAF phase covers this work?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的团队现在正在 Azure 中实际迁移、改进和构建工作负载。哪个 CAF 阶段涵盖这项工作？
questions.definition: 4. Adopt: How will we migrate, modernize, and build workloads?
questions.zh: 4. 采用：我们将如何迁移、现代化和构建工作负载？

questions.stem: Contoso moves its inventory app from its server room to Azure VMs without changing the app itself; only where it runs is different. Which kind of CAF work is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 把库存应用从机房搬到 Azure 虚拟机上，应用本身不做任何改动，只是运行的位置不同了。这是哪种 CAF 工作？
questions.definition: Migration changes where or how a workload runs. Modernization changes the workload to achieve a better outcome. An initiative can do both.
questions.zh: 迁移会改变工作负载的运行位置或运行方式。现代化会改变工作负载，以获得更好的结果。一项举措可以同时做到这两点。

questions.stem: Contoso's existing order app already runs in Azure, and the team now changes its platform and data layer so it better meets future business requirements. Which kind of CAF work is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 现有的订单应用已经在 Azure 中运行，团队现在要更改其平台和数据层，使其更好地满足未来的业务需求。这是哪种 CAF 工作？
questions.definition: Modernization improves an existing workload or workload component to better meet current or future business requirements. It can change different parts of a workload, such as its platform, application, data, or operating model.
questions.zh: 现代化会改进现有工作负载或工作负载组件，以更好地满足当前或未来的业务需求。它可以改变工作负载的不同部分，例如其平台、应用程序、数据或运营模式。
keys: 现有工作负载或工作负载组件
platform, application, data, or operating model
平台、应用程序、数据或运营模式

questions.stem: Contoso wants to build a brand-new cloud-native app that creates new business value, rather than move or improve an existing one. Which kind of CAF work is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 想构建一个全新的云原生应用来创造新的业务价值，而不是迁移或改进现有应用。这是哪种 CAF 工作？
questions.definition: A cloud-native solution creates business value by building new workloads or enhancing existing ones. Whether you're developing a new application or adding new features to an existing system, cloud-native development is a journey through planning, building, deploying, and optimizing your workloads.
questions.zh: 云原生解决方案创造业务价值，方式是构建新工作负载或增强现有工作负载。无论你是在开发新应用程序，还是在为现有系统添加新功能，云原生开发都是一段贯穿规划、构建、部署和优化工作负载的旅程。

questions.stem: Contoso's cloud team sets guardrails: policies, procedures and tools that define which cloud activities are acceptable, such as allowed regions and required tags. Which CAF methodology is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的云团队设置护栏：用策略、流程和工具来规定哪些云活动是可接受的，例如允许的区域和必需的标记。这是哪种 CAF 方法？
questions.definition: Cloud governance is how an organization controls its use of cloud services by establishing guardrails. These guardrails are a set of policies, procedures, and tools that define acceptable and unacceptable cloud activities.
questions.zh: 云治理是组织控制其云服务使用的方式，具体做法是建立护栏。这些护栏是一组策略、过程和工具，用于定义可接受和不可接受的云活动。
keys: controls its use of cloud services

questions.stem: Contoso wants a structured approach to protect its whole Azure estate against attacks, from identities to data. Which CAF methodology helps?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 希望用一种结构化的方法保护其整个 Azure 资产免受攻击，从身份到数据。哪种 CAF 方法有帮助？
questions.definition: The Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure Secure methodology provides a structured approach for securing your Azure cloud estate.
questions.zh: Azure 云采用框架的安全方法提供了一种结构化方式，用于保护你的 Azure 云资产。

questions.stem: Contoso's workloads are live in Azure, and the operations team must keep them running day to day while staying aligned with business goals over time. Which CAF methodology covers this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的工作负载已在 Azure 中上线，运维团队必须保证其日常运行，同时长期与业务目标保持一致。哪种 CAF 方法涵盖这项工作？
questions.definition: Managing your Azure environment isn't just about keeping the lights on. It's about maintaining governance and security while ensuring your cloud stays aligned with business goals over time.
questions.zh: 管理你的 Azure 环境不仅仅是维持系统正常运转。它关乎在保持治理和安全的同时，确保你的云随着时间推移始终与业务目标保持一致。

questions.stem: A Contoso engineer wants to browse a catalog of reference architectures, solution ideas and technology decision guides before designing a new web workload. Which Microsoft resource should they open?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一名工程师想在设计新的 Web 工作负载之前浏览一个包含参考架构、解决方案思路和技术决策指南的目录。他应该打开哪项 Microsoft 资源？
questions.definition: The Azure Architecture Center is a catalog of solution ideas, example workloads, reference architectures, technology decision guides, and architecture guides that help cloud architects and engineers build workloads ...
questions.zh: Azure 架构中心是一个目录，其中包含解决方案构想、示例工作负载、参考架构、技术决策指南和架构指南，可帮助云架构师和工程师构建工作负载……

questions.stem: Contoso wants to review the design of one workload so it becomes resilient, available, recoverable and as secure as it needs to be. Which design framework should it use?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 想审查某个工作负载的设计，使其具备弹性、可用、可恢复，并达到所需的安全程度。它应该使用哪个设计框架？
questions.definition: The Azure Well-Architected Framework is a design framework that can improve the quality of a workload by helping it to: Be resilient, available, and recoverable. Be as secure as you need it to be.
questions.zh: Azure 良好架构框架是一个设计框架，可以提高工作负载的质量，方法是帮助它做到：具有复原能力、可用且可恢复。按你的需要达到相应的安全程度。
keys: 具有复原能力、可用且可恢复

questions.stem: Contoso's leaders want one direction for the company's move to the cloud that links executive intent to measurable outcomes and sets the standards every workload team must work within. What should they create?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的领导层希望为公司上云确定统一方向，把高管意图与可衡量的成果联系起来，并制定每个工作负载团队都必须遵守的标准。他们应该制定什么？
questions.definition: A cloud adoption strategy directs how your business adopts cloud technology. It connects executive intent to measurable outcomes and sets the standards that every workload team operates within.
questions.zh: 云采用策略指导你的企业如何采用云技术。它将高管意图与可衡量的成果联系起来，并设定每个工作负载团队在其中运作的标准。

questions.stem: Before setting any goals, Contoso's leaders list why the company wants the cloud at all, such as cutting costs, meeting a deadline and launching new products, several reasons applying at once. What do these reasons represent?
questions.zhStem: 在设定任何目标之前，Contoso 的领导层列出公司为什么要上云，例如降低成本、赶上截止日期和推出新产品，多个原因同时存在。这些原因代表什么？
questions.definition: Various motivations can drive business transformations that are supported by cloud adoption. Several motivations likely apply at the same time.
questions.zh: 各种动机可以推动由云采用所支持的业务转型。可能同时有多个动机适用。

questions.stem: Contoso's datacenter lease ends in four months, so it must start moving workloads right away, in parallel with its strategy work. What kind of driver is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的数据中心租约四个月后到期，因此必须立即开始迁移工作负载，并与战略工作同时进行。这是哪种驱动因素？
questions.definition: When responding to critical business events is the highest priority, it's important to get started with migration early, often in parallel with strategy and planning efforts.
questions.zh: 当应对关键业务事件是最高优先级时，务必尽早开始迁移，并且通常与策略和规划工作并行进行。

questions.stem: Contoso wants to cut costs and reduce technical complexity, the most common reasons companies give for moving to the cloud, and no deadline is forcing the move. Which category of driver is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 想降低成本并减少技术复杂度，这是企业上云最常见的原因，而且没有截止日期在逼迫这次迁移。这属于哪类驱动因素？
questions.definition: The migration motivations listed near the top of the motivations table are the most common reasons for adopting the cloud but not necessarily the most significant.
questions.zh: 迁移动机列于动机表的顶部附近，它们是采用云的最常见原因，但不一定是最重要的原因。

questions.stem: Contoso wants the cloud so it can build new products and customer experiences on top of its data and insights. Which category of driver is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 想上云，以便基于其数据和洞察构建新产品和客户体验。这属于哪类驱动因素？
questions.definition: Data is the new commodity, and modern applications are the supply chain driving that data into various experiences. In today's business market, it's hard to find a transformative product or service that isn't built on top of data, insights, and customer experiences.
questions.zh: 数据是新的商品，而现代应用程序是将这些数据输送到各种体验中的供应链。在当今的商业市场中，很难找到不是建立在数据、见解和客户体验之上的变革性产品或服务。

questions.stem: Contoso's leaders want to state the concise, observable change in business performance they expect from the cloud, each backed by a specific measure. What are they defining?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的领导层希望说明他们期望通过上云带来的简洁、可观察的业务绩效变化，并为每一项配上具体的衡量指标。他们在定义什么？
questions.definition: This article series is designed to help customers identify business outcomes that are concise, defined, and drive observable results or change in business performance, supported by a specific measure.
questions.zh: 本系列文章旨在帮助客户确定业务成果，这些成果应简洁、明确，并能推动可观察的结果或业务绩效的变化，且有具体的衡量指标作为支撑。

questions.stem: Contoso will judge its cloud move by the revenue it gains and the costs it saves. Which type of result is it measuring?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 将根据获得的收入和节省的成本来评判其上云成效。它在衡量哪种成果？
questions.definition: Financial or fiscal performance is the cleanest business outcome for many business leaders, but not the only one.
questions.zh: 对于许多业务领导者来说，财务或财政绩效是最清晰的业务成果，但并不是唯一的成果。

questions.stem: Contoso wants to cut the time it takes to ship new features so it can respond to market changes quickly. Which type of result is it aiming for?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 希望缩短新功能上线所需的时间，以便快速响应市场变化。它追求的是哪种成果？
questions.definition: Today's fast-changing business environment places a premium on time. The ability to respond to and drive market change quickly is the fundamental measure of business agility.
questions.zh: 当今快速变化的商业环境非常重视时间。快速响应并推动市场变化的能力，是衡量业务敏捷性的基本指标。

questions.stem: Contoso wants to serve customers in new countries and stay compliant with the rules in each of those geographies. Which type of result is it aiming for?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 希望服务新国家的客户，并符合每个地区的法规。它追求的是哪种成果？
questions.definition: In a constantly shrinking market, global reach (ability to support global customers and users) can be measured by compliance in geographies that are relevant to the business.
questions.zh: 在不断缩小的市场中，全球覆盖范围（支持全球客户和用户的能力）可以通过在与业务相关的地理区域中的合规性来衡量。

questions.stem: Contoso's online store wants to respond faster to what shoppers ask for on social marketplaces. Which type of result is it aiming for?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的网店希望更快地回应购物者在社交市场上提出的需求。它追求的是哪种成果？
questions.definition: Social marketplaces are redefining winners and losers at an unheard-of pace. Responding to user needs is a key measure of customer engagement.
questions.zh: 社交市场正以前所未有的速度重新定义赢家和输家。响应用户需求是衡量客户互动的关键指标。

questions.stem: Contoso's booking site went down twice last year and hurt the brand, so the company wants it to stay fast and reliable. Which type of result is it aiming for?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的预订网站去年宕机两次，损害了品牌，因此公司希望它保持快速和可靠。它追求的是哪种成果？
questions.definition: Performance and reliability are assumed. When either falters, reputation damage can be painful and long-lasting.
questions.zh: 性能和可靠性被视为理所当然。当其中任何一个出现问题时，声誉损害可能是痛苦且长期的。

questions.stem: Contoso's board wants to lower the company's carbon footprint and make environmental goals part of its core business strategy. Which type of result is it aiming for?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的董事会希望降低公司的碳足迹，并把环境目标纳入核心业务战略。它追求的是哪种成果？
questions.definition: Environmental sustainability is quickly moving from a "nice to have" function of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) to a centerpiece of business strategy, increasingly embedded into everything a company does.
questions.zh: 环境可持续性正迅速从企业社会责任（CSR）中的“锦上添花”功能，转变为业务战略的核心，并日益融入公司所做的一切。

questions.stem: Contoso's CFO asks how the cloud move will change the company's balance sheet, accounting KPIs and budgeting processes. Which area of the strategy is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的首席财务官问上云将如何改变公司的资产负债表、会计 KPI 和预算流程。这属于战略的哪个方面？
questions.definition: A digital transformation goes hand-in-hand with a financial transformation. When you're making the shift to the cloud, there are financial considerations around how the cloud will impact your financial position, accounting KPIs, and processes...
questions.zh: 数字化转型与财务转型相辅相成。当你向云转变时，存在一些财务考量，涉及云将如何影响你的财务状况、会计 KPI 和流程……

questions.stem: Contoso's IT lead asks how the cloud move will change the way the team runs and maintains its environment and workloads. Which area of the strategy is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的 IT 负责人问上云将如何改变团队运行和维护其环境与工作负载的方式。这属于战略的哪个方面？
questions.definition: When you're making the shift to the cloud, there are technical considerations around how it will help improve how you manage and maintain your cloud and workloads.
questions.zh: 当你向云转变时，存在一些技术考量，涉及它将如何帮助你改进对云和工作负载的管理与维护方式。

questions.stem: Contoso's ticket site gets huge traffic during big events, so it wants to add resources when demand rises and remove them afterwards. Which technical benefit of the cloud is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的售票网站在大型活动期间流量巨大，因此希望在需求上升时增加资源，之后再减少资源。这是云的哪项技术优势？
questions.definition: Scalability, or the ability to scale out your resources depending on usage, utilization, and demand, is one of the foremost technical benefits of moving to the cloud.
questions.zh: 可扩展性，即根据使用情况、利用率和需求横向扩展你的资源的能力，是迁移到云的首要技术优势之一。

questions.stem: Contoso's online store must keep running even when a server or a whole datacenter fails, but building that kind of redundancy on-premises is too expensive. Which cloud benefit lets them reach this goal at a lower cost?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的网店即使在一台服务器甚至整个数据中心发生故障时也必须持续运行，但在本地构建这种冗余成本太高。哪项云优势能让他们以更低成本实现这一目标？
questions.definition: On-premises, it's more costly to build highly available infrastructure. It's less costly to architect highly available infrastructure in the cloud.
questions.zh: 在本地，构建高可用基础结构的成本更高。在云中设计高可用基础结构的成本更低。

questions.stem: Contoso's small IT team cannot keep up with new threats appearing on global networks, so leaders want a provider that keeps expanding its protective infrastructure and toolsets for them. Which cloud benefit are they counting on?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的小型 IT 团队跟不上全球网络上不断出现的新威胁，因此领导层希望由云服务商持续为他们扩展防护基础设施和工具集。他们依赖的是哪项云优势？
questions.definition: When it comes to security and compliance, Microsoft is continually expanding our security infrastructure and toolsets to keep you on par with what's transpiring with respect to security threats on global networks.
questions.zh: 在安全与合规方面，Microsoft 正在不断扩展我们的安全基础结构和工具集，让你能够跟上全球网络上安全威胁的动态。
keys: 安全基础结构和工具集

questions.stem: Contoso's servers sit mostly idle except during a short monthly reporting period, yet the company pays for them all year. Which cloud benefit would let them pay only for the resources they actually use over time?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的服务器除了每月很短的报表期之外大部分时间都处于空闲状态，但公司全年都在为它们付费。哪项云优势能让他们只为一段时间内实际使用的资源付费？
questions.definition: Capacity optimization, where you only pay for the resources you utilize over time, is another technical benefit of the cloud.
questions.zh: 容量优化，即你只需为一段时间内实际使用的资源付费，是云的另一项技术优势。

questions.stem: Before approving a move to Azure, Contoso's CFO asks for a document that shows the technical and financial timeline of the environment and a financial plan tied to business outcomes. What should the team prepare?
questions.zhStem: 在批准迁移到 Azure 之前，Contoso 的首席财务官要求一份文件，展示环境的技术与财务时间线，以及与业务成果挂钩的财务计划。团队应该准备什么？
questions.definition: A business case provides a view of the technical and financial timeline of your environment. Developing a business case includes building a financial plan that takes technical considerations into account and aligns with business outcomes.
questions.zh: 商业论证提供了你环境的技术和财务时间线视图。制定商业论证包括构建一份财务计划，该计划考虑技术考量并与业务成果保持一致。

questions.stem: Contoso's digital transformation is large and complex, so leaders decide to deliver it in phases, committing to one motivation category for a fixed period at a time. What is this phased approach called?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的数字化转型规模大且复杂，因此领导层决定分阶段推进，每次在一段固定时间内只专注于一个动机类别。这种分阶段的方法叫什么？
questions.definition: To create clarity and alignment, it's suggested that complex digital transformation projects align to an organization's horizons or phased program delivery. In this type of approach, the company commits to a single motivation category for a time-bound period.
questions.zh: 为了实现清晰性和一致性，建议复杂的数字化转型项目与组织的视野或分阶段的项目交付保持一致。在这种方法中，公司在限定的时间段内致力于单一的动机类别。
keys: 复杂的数字化转型项目

questions.stem: Contoso is starting its transformation program, and the first phase focuses on exiting the datacenter, preferring modern PaaS services over a basic copy of the existing servers. Which phase is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 正在启动转型计划，第一阶段专注于退出数据中心，并优先采用现代 PaaS 服务，而不是简单复制现有服务器。这是哪个阶段？
questions.definition: Prioritize the datacenter exit with a focus on modern platform as a service (PaaS) solutions over a basic lift-and-shift migration.
questions.zh: 优先考虑退出数据中心，重点关注现代的平台即服务（PaaS）解决方案，而不是基础的平移迁移。

questions.stem: Contoso has left its datacenter, and the next phase now focuses on improving how workloads are run, using cloud-native governance, operations management, security, and compliance capabilities. Which phase is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 已经撤出数据中心，下一阶段专注于改进工作负载的运行方式，利用云原生的治理、运营管理、安全与合规能力。这是哪个阶段？
questions.definition: Prioritize operational improvements built on cloud-native governance, operations management, security, and compliance capabilities.
questions.zh: 优先考虑运营改进，这些改进建立在云原生的治理、运营管理、安全和合规功能之上。

questions.stem: After migrating and improving operations, Contoso's team now has enough data and cloud skills to redesign its most complex architectures in depth. Which phase are they entering?
questions.zhStem: 在完成迁移并改进运营之后，Contoso 的团队现在拥有足够的数据和云技能，可以对其最复杂的架构进行深入的重新设计。他们正在进入哪个阶段？
questions.definition: With post-migration and operational improvements, the team will have sufficient data and cloud skills to perform deeper modernization of complex architectures.
questions.zh: 借助迁移后的改进和运营改进，团队将拥有足够的数据和云技能，对复杂架构执行更深入的现代化。

questions.stem: Contoso has saved capital by closing its datacenters, and its central IT staff have new skills, so leaders now redirect that money and talent to speed up continued innovation. Which phase is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 通过关闭数据中心节省了资本，其中央 IT 人员也掌握了新技能，因此领导层现在将这些资金和人才转向加速持续创新。这是哪个阶段？
questions.definition: Redirect capital reduction from datacenter exits and new skills in central IT to focus on accelerating continued innovation.
questions.zh: 将退出数据中心带来的资本削减和中央 IT 部门的新技能重新调配，以专注于加速持续创新。

questions.stem: Contoso has 300 applications and must decide, one by one, whether each should be moved as-is, changed, rewritten, replaced by SaaS, or kept where it is. What is this evaluation process called?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 有 300 个应用程序，必须逐个决定每个应用是原样迁移、修改、重写、用 SaaS 替换，还是保留原处。这个评估过程叫什么？
questions.definition: Cloud rationalization is the process of evaluating assets to determine the best way to migrate or modernize each asset in the cloud.
questions.zh: 云合理化是这样一个过程：评估资产，从而确定以最佳方式在云中迁移或现代化每项资产。

questions.stem: Contoso must move a stable inventory application to Azure virtual machines quickly, keeping its architecture almost exactly as it is today. Which strategy fits?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 必须将一个稳定的库存应用程序快速迁移到 Azure 虚拟机，并几乎完全保持其现有架构。哪种策略合适？
questions.definition: Also known as a lift and shift migration, a rehost effort moves a current state asset to the chosen cloud provider with minimal change to the overall architecture.
questions.zh: 也称为直接迁移（lift and shift）的重新托管工作，会将当前状态的资产迁移到所选的云提供商，并对整体架构做最小的更改。

questions.stem: Contoso's team creates Azure virtual machines and networks that mirror their on-premises datacenter, then moves the workloads onto that IaaS setup unchanged. What type of migration is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的团队创建了与本地数据中心对应的 Azure 虚拟机和网络，然后将工作负载原样迁移到这个 IaaS 环境中。这是哪种类型的迁移？
questions.definition: Lift-and-shift migration: You set up cloud resources similar to your on-premises datacenter, and then move your workloads to the IaaS infrastructure.
questions.zh: 平移迁移：你设置云资源，使其与你的本地数据中心类似，然后将你的工作负载移到 IaaS 基础结构。

questions.stem: Contoso wants to cut the operating costs of a web application by making small changes to its code so it fits a PaaS-based model. Which strategy is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 希望通过对代码做少量修改，使一个 Web 应用适配基于 PaaS 的模式，从而降低其运营成本。这是哪种策略？
questions.definition: Platform as a service (PaaS) options can reduce the operational costs that are associated with many applications. It's a good idea to slightly refactor an application to fit a PaaS-based model.
questions.zh: 平台即服务（PaaS）选项可以降低与许多应用程序相关的运营成本。一个好主意是稍微重构应用程序，使其适应基于 PaaS 的模型。

questions.stem: An aging Contoso application cannot run on Azure because of design decisions made when it was first built, so its structure must be changed before it can move. Which strategy is needed?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一个老旧应用由于最初构建时的设计决策而无法在 Azure 上运行，因此必须先改变其结构才能迁移。需要哪种策略？
questions.definition: Some aging applications aren't compatible with cloud providers. This incompatibility is because of the architectural decisions that were made when the application was built. In these cases, the application might need to be rearchitected before transformation.
questions.zh: 一些老旧的应用程序与云提供商不兼容。这种不兼容是由于构建应用程序时所做的架构决策造成的。在这些情况下，应用程序可能需要先重新架构，然后再进行转型。

questions.stem: Contoso's legacy order system is so far behind that further investment in its old code cannot be justified, so the team decides to write a brand-new code base designed for the cloud. Which strategy is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的旧订单系统落后太多，已不值得再投资其旧代码，因此团队决定编写一套为云设计的全新代码库。这是哪种策略？
questions.definition: In some scenarios, the delta that must be overcome to carry an application forward can be too large to justify further investment. ... To resolve the issue, create a new code base to align with a cloud-native approach.
questions.zh: 在某些场景中，要推动应用程序继续前进所必须克服的差距可能过大，以致无法证明进一步投资是合理的。……为了解决这个问题，请创建新的代码库，以与云原生方法保持一致。

questions.stem: Contoso's new app is designed, built, and operated in Azure from the start so that it takes full advantage of the cloud computing model. How is this approach described?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的新应用从一开始就在 Azure 中设计、构建和运行，以充分利用云计算模式。这种方法被称为什么？
questions.definition: Cloud-native architecture and technologies are an approach to designing, constructing, and operating workloads that are built in the cloud and take full advantage of the cloud computing model.
questions.zh: 云原生架构和技术是一种设计、构建和运营工作负载的方法，这些工作负载在云中构建，并充分利用云计算模型。
keys: take full advantage of the cloud computing model

questions.stem: Contoso's in-house email application does nothing that a SaaS product cannot already do, so the team schedules a switch to that product and drops the app from the migration effort. Which strategy is this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 自建的电子邮件应用的所有功能都能由一款 SaaS 产品完成，因此团队安排改用该产品，并将此应用从迁移工作中移除。这是哪种策略？
questions.definition: Sometimes software as a service (SaaS) applications can provide all the necessary functionality for the hosted application. In these scenarios, a workload can be scheduled for future replacement, which removes it from the transformation effort.
questions.zh: 有时，软件即服务（SaaS）应用程序可以为托管的应用程序提供所有必要的功能。在这些场景中，可以将工作负载安排在将来替换，从而将其从转型工作中移除。

questions.stem: Contoso's board states that, through cloud adoption, the company wants to increase agility and reduce costs across the organization. What do these high-level outcomes represent?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的董事会表示，希望通过采用云在整个组织范围内提高敏捷性并降低成本。这些高层次的成果代表什么？
questions.definition: Business goals are high-level outcomes the organization wants to achieve from cloud adoption, such as adopting AI, increasing agility, accelerating innovation, reducing costs, and improving resilience.
questions.zh: 业务目标是组织希望通过云采用实现的高层级成果，例如采用 AI、提高敏捷性、加速创新、降低成本和提升复原能力。

questions.stem: To support the company's aim of faster releases, Contoso notes that its billing workload must change because its hardware cannot scale during peak sales. What does this reason for changing the workload represent?
questions.zhStem: 为了支持公司加快发布的目标，Contoso 指出其计费工作负载必须改变，因为其硬件无法在销售高峰期扩展。这种说明工作负载为何必须改变的理由代表什么？
questions.definition: A business driver defines why a workload needs to change in order to support a specific business goal.
questions.zh: 业务驱动因素定义了工作负载为何需要变更，以支持特定业务目标。

questions.stem: For each workload, Contoso's architects now choose how it will move to Azure, such as keeping it as-is on VMs or switching to PaaS, based on why it needs to change. What are they defining?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的架构师现在针对每个工作负载，根据其需要改变的原因，选择它迁移到 Azure 的方式，例如原样保留在虚拟机上或改用 PaaS。他们正在定义什么？
questions.definition: A migration strategy defines how each workload transitions to Azure based on its business driver.
questions.zh: 迁移策略定义每个工作负载如何过渡到 Azure，依据是其业务驱动因素。

questions.stem: During assessment, Contoso finds an old reporting server that no one has used in two years and that no longer provides any business value. Which strategy fits it?
questions.zhStem: 在评估过程中，Contoso 发现一台两年无人使用、已不再提供任何业务价值的旧报表服务器。哪种策略适合它？
questions.definition: Retire decommissions workloads that no longer provide business value.
questions.zh: 停用会让工作负载退役，这些工作负载不再提供业务价值。

questions.stem: Contoso wants to move a web app from its own servers to a modern managed hosting environment such as App Service, with only minimal code changes. Which strategy fits?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 希望将一个 Web 应用从自有服务器迁移到 App Service 这类现代托管环境，只做最少的代码修改。哪种策略合适？
questions.definition: Replatforming moves workloads to a modern hosting environment with minimal code changes.
questions.zh: 更换平台会将工作负载迁移到现代托管环境，同时只需最少的代码更改。

questions.stem: Contoso's factory control system is stable, compliant, and meets all current and future needs, and there is no near-term reason to move it. Which strategy fits?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的工厂控制系统稳定、合规，满足当前和未来的所有需求，近期也没有迁移它的理由。哪种策略合适？
questions.definition: A retain strategy keeps workloads in their current environment when they're stable, compliant, and meet all current and future business needs with no near-term driver to move.
questions.zh: 保留策略会将工作负载保留在其当前环境中，前提是它们稳定、合规，满足所有当前和未来的业务需求，并且近期没有迁移的驱动因素。
keys: 近期没有迁移的驱动因素

questions.stem: Contoso's migration involves several teams, and people keep asking who does the work, who owns the result, who must be asked, and who just needs updates. What cross-team tool should they build?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的迁移涉及多个团队，大家不断询问谁做事、谁对结果负最终责任、需要征求谁的意见，以及谁只需要获得更新。他们应该建立什么跨团队工具？
questions.definition: Align responsibilities by developing a cross-team matrix that identifies responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed (RACI) parties.
questions.zh: 协调职责：制定一个跨团队矩阵，用于确定负责、批准、咨询和知情（RACI）的各方。

questions.stem: In Contoso's migration chart, the network and database teams are the ones who actually do the work and deliver the outcomes. Which role are they given?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso 的迁移分工表中，网络团队和数据库团队是实际执行工作并交付成果的团队。他们被分配的是哪个角色？
questions.definition: The teams that are responsible for the outcomes.
questions.zh: 负责产出结果的团队。

questions.stem: In Contoso's migration chart, exactly one team owns the final result of the identity function and answers for it. Which role does that team hold?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso 的迁移分工表中，只有一个团队拥有身份功能的最终结果并为其负责。该团队担任的是哪个角色？
questions.definition: The one team that is accountable for a function.
questions.zh: 唯一一个团队，对某项职能最终负责。

questions.stem: In Contoso's migration chart, the security team does not do the work but must be asked for input while the plan is being made. Which role does it have?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso 的迁移分工表中，安全团队不执行工作，但在制定计划时必须征求其意见。它担任的是哪个角色？
questions.definition: The teams that should be consulted during planning.
questions.zh: 应被咨询的团队，在规划期间。

questions.stem: In Contoso's migration chart, the help desk only needs to be told once the work is completed. Which role does it have?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso 的迁移分工表中，服务台只需要在工作完成后收到通知。它担任的是哪个角色？
questions.definition: The teams that should be informed when work is completed.
questions.zh: 应被告知的团队，在工作完成时。

questions.stem: Contoso's cloud governance team can no longer keep pace with the many adoption teams as cloud use grows, so the company hands cloud responsibilities to its existing in-house IT department. Which team takes them over?
questions.zhStem: 随着云使用的增长，Contoso 的云治理团队已跟不上众多采用团队的步伐，因此公司将云职责交给现有的内部 IT 部门。由哪个团队接手？
questions.definition: As adoption scales, the cloud governance team might struggle to keep pace with the flow of innovation from multiple cloud adoption teams... At this stage, it's common for companies to shift cloud responsibilities to an existing central IT team.
questions.zh: 随着采用规模扩大，云治理团队可能难以跟上来自多个云采用团队的创新步伐……在此阶段，公司通常会将云职责转移给现有的中央 IT 团队。
verbs: might struggle to keep pace with

questions.stem: Contoso has reached the highest level of cloud maturity and wants one group that aligns all teams around a modern cloud-first operating model and provides governance, security, platform, and automation centrally. What should it set up?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 已达到最高的云成熟度，希望由一个团体让所有团队围绕现代的云优先运营模式保持一致，并集中提供治理、安全、平台和自动化。它应该建立什么？
questions.definition: At the highest state of maturity, a cloud center of excellence aligns teams around a modern cloud-first operating model. This approach provides centralized IT functions like governance, security, platform, and automation.
questions.zh: 在最高成熟度状态下，云卓越中心围绕现代的云优先运营模式协调各团队。这种方法提供集中式 IT 职能，例如治理、安全、平台和自动化。

questions.stem: In Contoso's list of cloud functions, one function covers implementing the actual technical solutions in Azure, such as building and deploying workloads. Which function is it?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso 的云职能列表中，有一项职能负责在 Azure 中实现实际的技术方案，例如构建和部署工作负载。这是哪项职能？
questions.definition: Cloud adoption functions enable the implementation of technical solutions in the cloud.
questions.zh: 云采用职能支持在云中实施技术解决方案。

questions.stem: In Contoso's list of cloud functions, one function covers running and looking after the shared Azure platform day to day. Which function is it?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso 的云职能列表中，有一项职能负责日常运行和维护共享的 Azure 平台。这是哪项职能？
questions.definition: Operate and manage the cloud platform.
questions.zh: 运行并管理云平台。

questions.stem: At Contoso, one team sits at the center of the cloud effort and actually carries out the technical changes, such as migrating and modernizing workloads. Which team is it?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso，有一个团队处于云工作的核心，实际执行技术变更，例如迁移和现代化工作负载。这是哪个团队？
questions.definition: The nucleus of all cloud adoption efforts is the cloud adoption team. This team drives the technical changes that enable adoption.
questions.zh: 所有云采用工作的核心是云采用团队。该团队推动实现采用的技术变革。

questions.stem: At Contoso, one dedicated team makes sure adopted solutions meet quality standards and is accountable for platform maturity, platform operations, and automation, while other teams do the migrations. Which team is it?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso，有一个专门的团队确保所采用的方案达到质量标准，并对平台成熟度、平台运维和自动化负最终责任，而其他团队负责执行迁移。这是哪个团队？
questions.definition: ...a cloud governance team is dedicated to ensuring excellence in the solutions that are adopted. The cloud governance team is accountable for platform maturity, platform operations, governance, and automation.
questions.zh: ……云治理团队致力于确保所采用解决方案的卓越品质。云治理团队负责平台成熟度、平台运维、治理和自动化。

questions.stem: Before migrating, Contoso wants a proven, flexible Azure architecture for governing, securing, and scaling an environment made of many subscriptions. What should it deploy?
questions.zhStem: 在迁移之前，Contoso 需要一个经过验证、灵活的 Azure 架构，用于治理、保护和扩展由多个订阅组成的环境。它应该部署什么？
questions.definition: An Azure landing zone is a proven and flexible architecture for governing, securing, and scaling a multi-subscription Azure environment.
questions.zh: Azure 落地区是一种经过验证且灵活的架构，用于治理、保护和扩展多订阅 Azure 环境。

questions.stem: Contoso needs one centralized foundation that sets up governance, security, and shared resources such as networking and identity for all of its Azure workloads. Which part of the Azure setup provides this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 需要一个集中式基础，为其所有 Azure 工作负载建立治理、安全以及网络和身份等共享资源。Azure 环境中的哪个部分提供这一点？
questions.definition: The centralized foundation that establishes governance, security, and shared resources for all your Azure workloads.
questions.zh: 集中式基础，为所有 Azure 工作负载建立治理、安全和共享资源。

questions.stem: Contoso has dozens of Azure subscriptions and wants a structure that organizes them all and applies the same policies to every subscription beneath each level. What should it use?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 有几十个 Azure 订阅，希望用一个结构将它们全部组织起来，并对每一层下的所有订阅应用相同的策略。它应该使用什么？
questions.definition: The management group hierarchy provides the governance structure for the Azure environment. It organizes all of your Azure subscriptions and applies governance standards to those subscriptions.
questions.zh: 管理组层级为 Azure 环境提供治理结构。它组织你的所有 Azure 订阅，并对这些订阅应用治理标准。

questions.stem: Contoso's e-commerce team needs its own environment to deploy and run its application resources, while staying inside the guardrails set by the central platform. Where do they deploy?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的电商团队需要一个自己的环境来部署和运行其应用资源，同时遵守中央平台设定的防护规则。他们应该部署在哪里？
questions.definition: The environments where workload teams deploy and operate workload resources within the guardrails of the platform landing zone.
questions.zh: 工作负载团队在其中部署和运营工作负载资源的环境，位于平台落地区的护栏之内。

questions.stem: Contoso wants each department to get a separate Azure bill and its own scale limits, with resource groups organized beneath that unit. Which Azure unit of management, billing, and scale should it create per department?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 希望每个部门都有单独的 Azure 账单和各自的规模限制，并在该单元下组织资源组。它应该为每个部门创建哪个兼具管理、计费和规模功能的 Azure 单元？
questions.definition: In Azure, subscriptions are a unit of management, billing, and scale. Subscriptions let you organize resource groups and control billing separately from access.
questions.zh: 在 Azure 中，订阅是管理、计费和缩放的单位。订阅让你能够组织资源组，并将计费与访问分开控制。
keys: unit of management, billing, and scale
管理、计费和缩放的单位
将计费与访问分开控制

questions.stem: When designing its landing zone, Contoso wants to set up the foundation for day-to-day operations, such as monitoring and backup, across Azure, hybrid, and multicloud environments. Which design area covers this?
questions.zhStem: 在设计落地区时，Contoso 希望为跨 Azure、混合云和多云环境的日常运维（例如监控和备份）建立基础。哪个设计领域涵盖这一点？
questions.definition: This design area establishes a foundation for operations management across your Azure, hybrid, or multicloud environments.
questions.zh: 此设计领域为运营管理奠定基础，范围涵盖你的 Azure、混合或多云环境。

questions.stem: When designing its landing zone, Contoso needs tooling for compliance auditing and automated guardrails such as policies that block unapproved regions. Which design area covers this?
questions.zhStem: 在设计落地区时，Contoso 需要用于合规审计和自动化防护规则（例如阻止未经批准区域的策略）的工具。哪个设计领域涵盖这一点？
questions.definition: Use Azure governance to establish the tooling that you need to support cloud governance, compliance auditing, and automated guardrails.
questions.zh: 使用 Azure 治理来建立所需的工具，以支持云治理、合规性审核和自动化防护措施。

questions.stem: Contoso does not want to build its landing zones by hand, so it uses a Microsoft-provided package of infrastructure as code that deploys the environment following recommended practices. What is this package called?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 不想手动构建落地区，因此使用 Microsoft 提供的一套基础设施即代码包，按照推荐做法部署环境。这套包叫什么？
questions.definition: Microsoft-provided accelerators for both platform landing zone and workload landing zone scenarios use infrastructure as code to deploy Azure environments based on recommended practices.
questions.zh: Microsoft 提供的加速器适用于平台落地区和工作负载落地区两种场景，它们使用基础结构即代码来部署 Azure 环境，所依据的是建议做法。

questions.stem: Contoso runs its order system on servers in its own building and wants to move the application and its data onto a public provider's servers so it can stop buying hardware. What is this overall process called?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的订单系统运行在自家机房的服务器上，公司想把应用和数据搬到公有云提供商的服务器上，从而不再购买硬件。这一整体过程叫什么？
questions.definition: Cloud migration is the process of moving applications and data from one location—often a company's private, on-premises servers—to a public cloud provider's servers, but it can also entail moving resources between different clouds.
questions.zh: 云迁移是将应用程序和数据从一个位置（通常是公司私有的本地服务器）迁移到公有云提供商的服务器的过程，但它也可能涉及在不同云之间迁移资源。
keys: 公有云提供商的服务器

questions.stem: Contoso's payroll process relies on two VMs, a SQL database, some scripts and a file share. What is this collection of IT components that together support one business process called?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的薪资流程依赖两台虚拟机、一个 SQL 数据库、一些脚本和一个文件共享。这些共同支撑一个业务流程的 IT 组件集合叫什么？
questions.definition: A workload is a collection of IT components, such as servers, virtual machines (VMs), cloud services, applications, code, data, or appliances, that support one or more business processes.
questions.zh: 工作负载是一组 IT 组件，例如服务器、虚拟机（VM）、云服务、应用程序、代码、数据或设备，这些组件支持一个或多个业务流程。

questions.stem: Contoso wants something running inside its own datacenter that keeps collecting configuration and performance data from its servers and sends it to Azure. What should the team deploy?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 希望在自家数据中心里运行一个组件，持续收集服务器的配置和性能数据并发送到 Azure。团队应部署什么？
questions.zhTerm: Azure Migrate 设备（发现用虚拟机）
questions.definition: The Azure Migrate appliance is a virtual appliance that can be deployed on a server in your datacenter. The appliance collects the configuration and performance data for your servers and continually sends it to the Azure Migrate service.
questions.zh: Azure Migrate 设备是一种虚拟设备，可部署在你数据中心的服务器上。该设备收集服务器的配置和性能数据，并持续将其发送到 Azure Migrate 服务。

questions.stem: Contoso wants one Azure service that guides the whole move: finding the best path, checking whether servers can run in Azure, estimating hosting cost, and then performing the move with little downtime. Which service should it use?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 想用一个 Azure 服务来指导整个迁移：找到最佳路径、检查服务器能否在 Azure 上运行、估算托管成本，然后以很少的停机时间完成迁移。应使用哪个服务？
questions.definition: Azure Migrate is a service that helps you decide on, plan, and execute your migration to Azure. Azure Migrate helps you find the best migration path, assess for Azure readiness and cost of hosting workloads on Azure, and perform the migration with minimal downtime and risk.
questions.zh: Azure Migrate 是一项服务，可帮助你决定、规划和执行到 Azure 的迁移。Azure Migrate 可帮助你找到最佳迁移路径，评估 Azure 就绪性以及在 Azure 上托管工作负载的成本，并以最短的停机时间和最低的风险执行迁移。
keys: 最短的停机时间和最低的风险

questions.stem: Before planning anything, Contoso's team must first find out which servers and applications it actually runs. What is this first step of the migration journey called?
questions.zhStem: 在做任何规划之前，Contoso 团队必须先弄清楚自己实际运行着哪些服务器和应用。迁移旅程的这第一步叫什么？
questions.definition: The first step in a migration journey is to identify your workloads. This process of identification is called discovery.
questions.zh: 迁移之旅的第一步是识别你的工作负载。这一识别过程称为发现。

questions.stem: An old runbook tells Contoso's team to inventory servers with a Microsoft tool that was retired in March 2024, and Azure Migrate should now be used instead. Which tool does the runbook name?
questions.zhStem: 一份旧的操作手册让 Contoso 团队用一个已于 2024 年 3 月退役的 Microsoft 工具来盘点服务器，现在应改用 Azure Migrate。手册里提到的是哪个工具？
questions.zhTerm: Movere（已退役的发现评估工具）
questions.definition: Movere: The Movere service retired on March 1, 2024. Users should use Azure Migrate for the discovery and assessment of on-premises workloads.
questions.zh: Movere：Movere 服务已于 2024 年 3 月 1 日停用。用户应使用 Azure Migrate 来发现和评估本地工作负载。

questions.stem: Contoso has an inventory of its on-premises servers and now wants a report that measures whether they can run in Azure and estimates the effect of moving them. What should it create?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 已有本地服务器清单，现在需要一份报告，衡量这些服务器能否在 Azure 上运行，并估计迁移它们的影响。应创建什么？
questions.definition: An assessment with the Discovery and assessment tool measures the readiness and estimates the effect of migrating on-premises servers to Azure.
questions.zh: 评估（使用发现和评估工具进行）会衡量就绪情况，并估算将本地服务器迁移到 Azure 的影响。

questions.stem: In a report, Contoso's team only wants to know whether each server, SQL server and web app can be moved to Azure at all, not what it will cost or what size it needs. Which part should the team look at?
questions.zhStem: 在报告中，Contoso 团队只想知道每台服务器、SQL 服务器和 Web 应用究竟能否迁到 Azure，而不关心成本或所需规格。团队应查看哪一部分？
questions.definition: Azure readiness: Assess whether on-premises servers, SQL servers, and web apps are ready for migration to Azure.
questions.zh: Azure 就绪度：评估本地服务器、SQL 服务器和 Web 应用是否已准备好迁移到 Azure。

questions.stem: Contoso wants to know how large each Azure VM should be, which Azure SQL configuration to pick, and how many Azure VMware Solution nodes it will need after the move. Which part of the report answers this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 想知道迁移后每台 Azure 虚拟机应选多大、Azure SQL 用哪种配置、需要多少个 Azure VMware Solution 节点。报告的哪一部分回答这个问题？
questions.definition: Right-sizing: Estimate the size of Azure virtual machines (VMs), the Azure SQL configuration, and the number of Azure VMware Solution nodes after migration.
questions.zh: 合理定型：估算 Azure 虚拟机（VM）的大小、Azure SQL 配置，以及迁移后 Azure VMware Solution 节点的数量。

questions.stem: Contoso's finance manager asks how much Azure will bill each month if the current on-premises servers run there. Which part of the report answers this?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的财务经理问：如果现有本地服务器放到 Azure 上运行，Azure 每月会收多少钱。报告的哪一部分回答这个问题？
questions.definition: Azure cost estimation: Estimate costs for running on-premises servers in Azure.
questions.zh: Azure 成本估算：估算在 Azure 中运行本地服务器的成本。

questions.stem: Contoso fears that moving its web servers without the database server they call would break the app, so it wants to see which servers talk to each other over the network. What should it run?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 担心只迁移 Web 服务器而漏掉它们调用的数据库服务器会让应用出故障，因此想看清哪些服务器之间有网络通信。应执行什么？
questions.definition: Dependency analysis: Understand the network dependencies between servers in your datacenter so that you can make high-confidence migration plans without missing any critical dependency.
questions.zh: 依赖分析：了解数据中心内服务器之间的网络依赖关系，以便制定高可信度的迁移计划，而不会遗漏任何关键依赖关系。

questions.stem: Contoso has finished evaluating its servers and is ready to actually move them to Azure, using the Azure Migrate tool built specifically for server migration. Which tool should it use?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 已完成服务器评估，准备用 Azure Migrate 中专为服务器迁移打造的工具，把服务器真正迁到 Azure。应使用哪个工具？
questions.definition: The Migration and modernization tool is purpose-built for server migration to Azure. It's optimized for migration.
questions.zh: 迁移和现代化工具专为服务器迁移到 Azure 而构建。它针对迁移进行了优化。
